instruction: Could you configure Chrome to automatically block all websites that use more than 10 MB of data per page load? I have a limited data plan and need to avoid data-heavy websites.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not provide settings to automatically block websites based on data usage thresholds. While Chrome has a 'Lite mode' or data saver feature (on some platforms) that can reduce data usage, it cannot block sites preemptively based on their data consumption before or during page load.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - Chrome does not provide settings to block websites based on data usage thresholds
The infeasible() evaluator is semantically appropriate since the requested functionality does not exist in Chrome
Chrome's Data Saver feature only compresses data but cannot preemptively block sites based on per-page data consumption
No verification logic is needed or possible for impossible functionality
The metadata explanation accurately describes why this task cannot be completed
